name: ticketmaster
description: Ticketmaster Discovery API integration — search live events by keyword, city, date window, and genre; look up full event details including on-sale dates and price ranges; find performers (attractions) and their upcoming shows; search venues; browse the segment/genre taxonomy; and get typeahead suggestions. Authenticates with a free self-serve Consumer Key (apikey query parameter) from developer.ticketmaster.com. Event data is provided by the Ticketmaster Discovery API and is biased toward Ticketmaster-ticketed events; API access may not be resold and responses should only be cached briefly per Ticketmaster's terms.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Live event, attraction, and venue discovery via the Ticketmaster Discovery API

fields.label: Consumer Key (API Key)
fields.helpText: Consumer Key of your app on developer.ticketmaster.com (Discovery API access is granted to every app by default).

tools.name: ticketmaster.search_events
tools.description: Search live events by keyword, city, country, date window, and/or classification (e.g. Music, Sports). Returns trimmed event summaries: name, date, venue, price ranges, and ticket URL. Deep paging is capped at the first 1000 results.

city.description: Filter by city name, e.g. Boston

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, DE

startDateTime.description: Only events starting after this instant (ISO 8601 with Z, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z)

endDateTime.description: Only events starting before this instant (ISO 8601 with Z)

classificationName.description: Segment/genre filter, e.g. Music, Sports, Rock, Comedy

tools.name: ticketmaster.get_event
tools.description: Get full details of a single event by id, including start dates, status, public on-sale window, venue, performers, classifications, price ranges, and seatmap URL.

tools.name: ticketmaster.search_attractions
tools.description: Search attractions (performers, artists, teams) by keyword. Returns id, name, and classification names.

keyword.description: Attraction name to search for, e.g. Coldplay

tools.name: ticketmaster.get_attraction_events
tools.description: List upcoming events for a specific attraction (performer/team) by attraction id.

tools.name: ticketmaster.search_venues
tools.description: Search venues by keyword. Returns id, name, city, state, and country.

keyword.description: Venue name to search for, e.g. Madison Square Garden

tools.name: ticketmaster.list_classifications
tools.description: List the Ticketmaster classification taxonomy: segments (Music, Sports, Arts & Theatre, ...) with their genres.

tools.name: ticketmaster.suggest
tools.description: Typeahead suggestions for a partial keyword: matching attractions, venues, and events.
